Normal polarity (E11) preserves the physical bits. The compatibility sets in E07, E10, and E08 intersect only at none_of_the_above. E03 repeats E08 and provides no independent confirmation. Each one-bit alternative—actuator_stiction, circulation_loss, and sensor_bias—contradicts one distinct physical measurement; controller_timing_fault contradicts all three. Cached E02/E20/E19 jointly favor circulation_loss, but E14 and the independent audit E01 establish that their source is stale, undermining their relevance to the current fault. Circulation_loss is therefore only a provisional strongest alternative, not better supported than the other one-bit alternatives by current physical evidence. Probabilities are judgmental rather than calibrated because measurement error rates and candidate priors are unspecified.
